description: The repository that holds this record asks the principal to endorse and grant it for one contract: the proof that the subject DID of a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.events.guest.requesterDid event controls this repository. Record key: the principal DID.

principal.description: The DID asked to write the endorsement and the grant.

contract.description: The principal's market.accept of the contract whose guest runs this repository's requester.

nonce.description: The nonce the principal put into that contract's secrets bundle.

accounts.description: The DIDs of the co-located accounts this repository's requester created for the contract, each with the principal's rotation key first, so the principal can tombstone them when the guest is gone.
